requirements.goal: One universal, Rust-native build/automation entry point (cargo xtask) for every package bones builds, replacing the duplicated ps1 scripts; plans updated with Android as future work.
requirements.constraints: No new required toolchain beyond Rust + existing C compiler/CMake for SDL. Install nothing automatically. Windows ARM64 primary, portable code. Same outputs as today (dist zip layout, test gates, example .wasm and dist folders).
requirements.done: cargo xtask test / dist / example reproduce what the ps1 scripts did and test is green; ps1 scripts removed; .gitignore clean; docs and roadmap current with Android planned.
requirements.outOfScope: Implementing Android support (planned only); mise/tool provisioning; CI setup; vendor/pubsub-bus changes (stashed edits stay stashed).

increments.description: xtask crate + cargo alias; prerequisite-check module with install hints (rust targets, C compiler, cmake, ninja preference, MSVC vcvarsall); cargo xtask test ported from test.ps1; delete test.ps1 and scripts/native-build-env.ps1; .gitignore cleanup.
cargo xtask dist (same zip layout + checksum) and cargo xtask example <name> from a table; delete dist.ps1 and all 15 examples/*/build.ps1.

README, docs/contributing, example READMEs, code comments referencing ps1; docs/roadmap.md outdated items removed and Android (SDLActivity APK, bones-android crate, cargo xtask android preflight) added; ADR for the xtask build system.

requests.text: Replace the PowerShell build system (test.ps1, dist.ps1, scripts/native-build-env.ps1, every examples/*/build.ps1) with a universal cargo xtask that owns dependency checks, automation logic, and every package build
Shared prerequisite checks: each missing tool fails fast with where/how to install it; nothing is installed automatically
Update the plans (docs/roadmap.md): remove outdated items and add Android support as planned future work using the design from this session
Remove outdated content from the docs, including every reference to the replaced ps1 scripts
Proper .gitignore entries: add .artifacts/, fix stale comments, drop dead entries

questions.text: Scope of "Android support": engine runs WASM extensions on an Android device as an APK (shipped engine + bundled extensions), or also embedding as a library in a host Android app?
questions.answer: Whatever is easiest for a simple app: standalone APK.

questions.text: Which native modules must work on Android in this branch: renderer+input+audio (SDL3) only, or also egui UI, wry web panels (Android WebView), game-core, persistence? Tray, self-update, single-instance, desktop registration, OS module are assumed out of scope.
questions.answer: Use every module that supports Android out of the box; skip the rest.

questions.text: How do extensions arrive on device: bundled into APK assets only, or also loaded from app storage (enabling hot reload over adb push)?
Target ABIs and min API level (suggest arm64-v8a only, API 26+)? Is there a physical device or emulator to verify on, and is Android SDK/NDK installed here?
Definition of done: APK builds via one pwsh script and hello-demo + one sprite example run on device — or more?
questions.answer: Fine: one pwsh script builds the APK; hello-demo and a sprite example run on device.

questions.text: Android SDK, NDK, and JDK 17 are not installed and no Android Rust target is present. May I install them (Android command-line tools + NDK r27 + platform 35 under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Android\Sdk, Temurin JDK 17 via winget, rustup target aarch64-linux-android, cargo-ndk)? And verify on a physical phone over adb, or an emulator (arm64 emulator on Windows ARM is limited)?
questions.answer: Do not install. android.ps1 runs a preflight that checks each prerequisite (JDK 17, ANDROID_HOME/SDK, platform 35, build-tools, NDK, rustup aarch64-linux-android target, cargo-ndk, adb/device for install) and fails with a clear message and where/how to install it. Device verification is done by the user after installing.

approvals.note: User: "A. Plus update the plans, remove outdated from docs, add the android thing. Use this WF only for the proper building" + "add proper gitignore entries to the repo as well."
User: "y" in reply to "Say implement and I will build all three increments"
